p1:
You are an expert academic illustrator for NeurIPS, ICLR and CVPR. Create a publication-ready academic architecture diagram, professional, clean, modern, minimalist, flat vector-illustration appearance inspired by DeepMind/OpenAI scientific diagrams. Pure white background, no texture, NO shadows, no 3D, no photographs, no cartoons, no sketch marks. Use muted pastel blue, sage, peach and lavender fills with thin readable dark outlines and charcoal text. All text English only, short labels, large legible typography. No paragraphs or complex equations. Wide landscape composition for a full-width figure in an A4 two-column paper, clear hierarchy and ample but economical whitespace. Scientific information and arrow directions must be accurate.
METHOD: A controlled protein directed-evolution workflow operating on a fixed candidate pool with hidden labels. Draw a clear left-to-right central pipeline of five labeled modules: "Data Analyst" -> "Hypothesis Generator" -> "Mutation Designer" -> "Fitness Evaluator" -> "Scientific Critic". Mark Hypothesis Generator and Scientific Critic with small pastel sage badges "LLM"; the other three with pastel blue badges "Code". Simple small scientific vector icons inside each module (data bars, hypothesis lightbulb, sequence tiles, ranking bars, checklist). At left an input "Measured data" enters Data Analyst. Above Mutation Designer place "Prior rules", connected down to it, with small label "HD / BLOSUM". After Scientific Critic, an arrow goes to a lower-right module "Batch validation", then flows left along a lower path to "Freeze batch" then "Oracle lookup" then "Update data"; Update data loops to Measured data. It must be unambiguous that validation then freezing happen BEFORE Oracle lookup, and that Oracle lookup is the only measurement step. At bottom a narrow lavender strip "Event log" receives thin dashed connectors from workflow, labeled only "Provenance". Add a small legend "Solid: workflow    Dashed: logging". Title at top left: "Controlled directed evolution". Short subtitle: "Five roles, two LLM interfaces". No claims of causal proof or absolute immutability. Do not add any other text.
p5:
You are an expert academic illustrator for NeurIPS, ICLR and CVPR. Create a publication-ready academic architecture diagram, professional, clean, modern, minimalist, flat vector-illustration appearance inspired by DeepMind/OpenAI scientific diagrams. Pure white background, no texture, NO shadows, no 3D, no photographs, no cartoons, no sketch marks. Use muted pastel blue, sage, peach and lavender fills with thin readable dark outlines and charcoal text. All text English only, short labels, large legible typography. No paragraphs or complex equations. Wide landscape composition for a full-width figure in an A4 two-column paper, clear hierarchy and ample but economical whitespace. Scientific information and arrow directions must be accurate.
METHOD: Proposed governed improvement architecture; NOT a claim of deployed autonomous self-improvement. Title "Governed improvement" and subtitle "Proposed architecture". Design two visually distinct horizontal loops, top titled "INNER LOOP · Experiment execution", bottom titled "OUTER LOOP · Proposed improvement". Upper loop contains three modules "Executor" -> "Verifier" -> "Controller", Controller loops back to Executor via a clear top return arrow labeled "Next batch". Under these a central slim lavender band "Evidence store" with short four tokens "Events · Facts · Decisions · Tasks", accepting a thin downward arrow from the top loop. Lower loop flows from Evidence store downward into "Memory" -> "Improver" -> "Sandbox evaluation". Only after Sandbox evaluation does a distinct "Regression gate" connect upward to Executor, with that upward arrow labeled "Accept". A separate arrow from Regression gate labeled "Reject" goes to a small box "Keep current policy". There must be NO direct route from Improver to deployed Executor bypassing Regression gate. Use small elegant vector icons for modules: experiment tray, checklist, sliders, archive, branching hypothesis, test grid. All labels readable and short; rigorous dataflow, crisp arrowheads, no crossed arrows, no paragraphs.
